actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.push_message.description: Send a text message to a LINE user or group chat.
actions.push_message.props.quotaNote.des: Each person who gets the message, including every group member, counts toward your LINE plan's monthly message limit.
actions.push_message.props.userId.descri: User, group or room ID. Map it from Source in the New Message trigger.
auth.description:
To get your channel access token:
1. Open the [LINE Developers Console](https://developers.line.biz/console/) and pick your Messaging API channel.
2. Go to the **Messaging API** tab.
3. Under **Channel access token (long-lived)**, click **Issue** and copy the token.
triggers.new-message.description: Starts the flow when your LINE bot receives a message.
triggers.new-message.props.md.descriptio:
**Connect this trigger to your LINE bot**

1. **Publish this flow first.** LINE checks the URL when you click **Verify**.
2. Open the [LINE Developers Console](https://developers.line.biz/console/), pick your Messaging API channel and go to the **Messaging API** tab.
3. Under **Webhook settings**, click **Edit** and paste this URL:

   ```text
   {{webhookUrl}}
   ```

4. Click **Verify**, then turn on **Use webhook**.

A channel has one webhook URL, so only the flow whose URL you paste receives messages.
